summary: Configured Apache 2.4.18 on node1 to serve the legacy report bundle on TCP 8080. `/` serves `public/`, `/cgi-bin/report` executes and preserves the warehouse report output, and private/source content remains unpublished. Service and data recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured `public/` as the document root and `cgi-bin/` as a CGI ScriptAlias.
Enabled and started Apache on TCP 8080.
Verified static content, CGI output, access isolation, OS/kernel retention, and reboot persistence.

evidence.requirement: Serve static files from public/ at /
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, `/` returned HTTP 200 with the Warehouse reports page.
The supplied script and live CGI endpoint both returned `warehouse=west` and `open_orders=7`; HTTP content type was text/plain.

evidence.requirement: Keep application source and private/ outside published content
evidence.summary: Filesystem mapping separates public, CGI, and private content. `/private/report-source.txt` and `/handover.conf` returned 404, while CGI directory listing returned 403.

evidence.requirement: Use TCP port 8080 with a persistent service
evidence.summary: Apache is active, enabled, configuration-valid, and listening on TCP 8080.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed legacy OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Node remains Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic and uses the native Apache 2.4.18 package.

Healthy baseline used boot ID ac73b359-243e-418e-b7bb-a7cff423e597; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 29f0ae77-e3d0-4cb6-a466-0899c5470381; Apache, listener, asset checksums, static page, CGI output, and isolation all recovered.
